name: A — Benign transit
description: A single small rotary-wing aircraft crosses the monitored airspace from west to east at a steady 22 m/s and 120 m, never coming closer than 2.6 km to the site reference point. Nothing about it is unusual.
purpose: The baseline. Everything downstream must be able to see an object, hold one stable track on it for the whole transit, and still decide that nothing needs an operator's attention. A system that cannot stay quiet here will be ignored when it matters.
expected_behaviour: must form exactly one confirmed track and hold it for the whole transit
must not fragment the track into several identities
must not alert: risk stays at or below LOW and the recommendation stays MONITOR
must not report a zone entry — the object never enters a restricted or protected zone

objects.description: Small rotary-wing aircraft transiting west to east, well clear of the site.
